contactAddress: 5821 Cedar Lake Road Suite 208 Minneapolis, MN 55416

suburbs.name: Apple Valley
suburbs.housingCharacter: Two generations of housing. Older additions such as Scott Highlands are full of 1970s split-entry and three-level split homes, with a short stair run up and down from the front door. Cobblestone Lake is newer, built from the early 2000s through the mid-2010s around a 36-acre lake, with single-family homes, townhomes and detached villas on small, tidy yards.

conditions.condition: Cobblestone Lake has a 1.5-mile paved trail, docks and a shared pool used year round
conditions.implication: Walkers, dogs and kids coming in off the trail and the dock bring sand, damp and grass clippings onto entry floors and the first few stairs.

conditions.condition: Many older homes are 1970s split-entry and three-level splits
conditions.implication: The landing at the front door and the two short stair runs off it take the heaviest foot traffic in the house, so carpeted stairs and the entry tile need attention every visit.

suburbs.name: Farmington
suburbs.housingCharacter: Two kinds of neighbourhood. Close to the historic downtown, lots are compact and the homes are older, a few from the early 1900s but most built in the 1950s, 60s and 70s. Further out the city is newer subdivisions and townhome communities, with a citywide median build year of 1997 and new single-family homes, one-level villas and townhomes still going up.

conditions.condition: Active new-construction communities such as Meadowview Preserve and Vermillion Commons
conditions.implication: Fine drywall and site dust keeps settling on sills, vents, baseboards and cabinet tops for months after move-in, and mud from unfinished lots and streets comes in on shoes.

conditions.condition: Older homes around the historic downtown, mostly 1950s to 1970s, on compact lots
conditions.implication: Older trim, original floors and tighter rooms collect dust in corners and along woodwork, so detail work on baseboards and door frames matters more than square footage.

suburbs.name: Rosemount
suburbs.housingCharacter: Most homes were built in the early 2000s, with a few 1950s houses near the older core and a steady run of brand-new construction, around 300 new single-family homes a year. Styles range from condo and townhouse clusters to ranch, split-level and Craftsman-influenced single-family homes. Newer building is concentrated in master-planned communities such as Amber Fields, where townhomes and single-family homes are connected to a central park.

conditions.condition: Amber Fields is still being built out, with several builders working at once
conditions.implication: Construction dust drifts into newly finished homes and settles on window tracks, vents and ledges, and muddy lots mean grit on entry floors well after move-in.

conditions.condition: Amber Fields has about 4.5 miles of paths and trails around a central park, and Bloomfield sits by a park with walking trails
conditions.implication: Daily walks with kids and dogs bring dirt, grass and damp in through the front door, so entries, mudrooms and the first stretch of flooring need the most attention.

suburbs.name: Lakeville
suburbs.housingCharacter: Mostly newer housing: the median home in the Dakota County part of Lakeville was built around 2000, with a good share from 1970 to 1999 and new construction still going up on the east side. Ramblers, including walkout ramblers, and two-story homes are common in communities like Spirit of Brandtjen Farm. Around Lake Marion, homes from the 1990s sit right on the water with their own lake frontage.

conditions.condition: Lake Marion and Orchard Lake, the city's two largest lakes, are lined with homes and private docks
conditions.implication: Sand, lake water and wet swimwear come straight in from the dock in summer, so walkout lower levels, patio doors and bathrooms near the lake entrance take the most wear.

conditions.condition: Spirit of Brandtjen Farm has trails around its lakes and two outdoor pools
conditions.implication: Pool and trail traffic means damp towels, chlorine drips and tracked-in grass on entry floors, plus walkout rambler basements that see as much traffic as the main floor.

suburbs.name: Eagan
suburbs.housingCharacter: Most of Eagan's housing went up between 1970 and 1999, so homes are established rather than old, with a smaller share built since 2000. Neighborhoods such as Blackhawk mix medium to large single-family homes with townhomes, and split-level homes are common around Lexington Square.

conditions.condition: Lebanon Hills Regional Park, about 2,000 acres of wooded trails, lakes, ponds and wetlands, sits inside Eagan
conditions.implication: Hikers, paddlers, skiers and their dogs bring trail dirt, sand and damp gear back through the entry, so mudroom floors, entry rugs and the laundry area need extra attention.

conditions.condition: Many homes are split-levels built from the 1970s through the 1990s
conditions.implication: The short stair runs off the front landing carry most of the household's foot traffic, so stair carpet and the entry floor get the hardest wear.

suburbs.name: Burnsville
suburbs.housingCharacter: Much of Burnsville was built from about 1970 into the early 1990s, and split-entry (bi-level) and multi-level split homes are everywhere, often on quiet cul-de-sacs in established neighborhoods like Chateaulin. Around Crystal Lake, older ramblers and larger homes sit on lakeshore lots in additions such as Oak Shores.

conditions.condition: Crystal Lake, nearly 300 acres with a public beach and boat launch, is ringed by lakeshore homes
conditions.implication: Swimmers and boaters track sand and lake water in through the lake-side door, so walkout floors, entry rugs and bathrooms near the back of the house need the most attention.

conditions.condition: Split-entry and multi-level split homes from the 1970s and 1980s are the most common style
conditions.implication: Every trip through the house crosses a short stair run, so the stair carpet and the landing by the front door wear fastest and need a thorough vacuum each visit.

suburbs.name: Bloomington
suburbs.housingCharacter: Bloomington is mostly established single-family housing from the middle of the last century, with a median build year around 1968. Mid-century ramblers and split-levels (split-entry, three-level and four-level splits) are the common styles, alongside condos and some waterfront homes. On the west side, walkout ramblers sit on wooded lots and along the Minnesota River bluffs.

conditions.condition: West Bloomington homes sit beside Hyland Lake Park Reserve, Bush Lake Beach, Normandale Lake Park and the Hyland Hills ski area
conditions.implication: Households that walk the park trails, swim at the beach or ski come home with sand, mud and wet gear, so the entry, mudroom and walkout lower level collect most of the grit.

conditions.condition: Homes along the Minnesota River bluffs, near the river-valley trails and the wildlife refuge
conditions.implication: Wooded bluff lots mean leaf litter, pollen and trail dirt tracked onto floors, and big view windows that show every smudge and need regular glass cleaning.

conditions.condition: Many homes are mid-century split-levels and split-entry houses
conditions.implication: The front landing and the short stair runs off it take the heaviest foot traffic, so stairs and entry floors need attention every visit.

suburbs.name: Shakopee
suburbs.housingCharacter: Shakopee's homes are among the newest in the metro, with only a small share built before 1970. Southbridge, in the northeast of the city, is mostly two-story and modified two-story homes from about 1999 to 2002, with some multi-level splits, while Amberglen is a newer neighborhood of four- and five-bedroom homes with three-car garages, including raised ranch plans. The oldest homes sit near Downtown Shakopee along the Minnesota River.

conditions.condition: Southbridge has a walking trail leading to a playground and an off-leash dog park
conditions.implication: Dog walks and trips to the park bring paw prints, grass and dirt in through the entry, so floors by the door, rugs and pet hair on furniture need attention every visit.

suburbs.name: Eden Prairie
suburbs.housingCharacter: Mostly 1980s and later: the city's median year built is 1987. Older streets like Cardinal Creek have large early-1980s homes, some over 5,000 finished square feet. Bearpath is a gated golf community built around 1997 to 2002, with custom two-story homes and single-story golf villas under a homeowners association.

conditions.condition: Bearpath is a gated community with staffed access around a Jack Nicklaus 18-hole golf course
conditions.implication: Crews are cleared through the gate ahead of each visit, and fine clippings from the fairways come in on shoes and settle on entry floors and patio-door tracks.

conditions.condition: Many homes are large, from early-1980s houses over 5,000 square feet to custom builds
conditions.implication: Big square footage means more finished rooms, more stairs and more glass than a crew can rush, so the visit is planned room by room.

suburbs.name: Hopkins
suburbs.housingCharacter: Hopkins is a compact, older suburb: more than a third of its housing went up between 1940 and 1969, and apartments make up over half of all homes. Single-family streets such as the walkable Avenues neighborhood near downtown are lined with 1950s ramblers, many with later additions.

conditions.condition: The Lake Minnetonka Regional Trail, a rails-to-trails biking and hiking path, runs through Hopkins, and Minnehaha Creek backs onto some yards
conditions.implication: Bikes, strollers and dogs coming in off the trail and the creek path track grit and damp onto entry floors and into garages that open into the house.

conditions.condition: Much of the housing is apartments and 1950s-era ramblers
conditions.implication: Smaller, single-level floor plans mean kitchens, baths and living areas share the same traffic paths, so floors and high-touch surfaces need attention every visit.

suburbs.name: St. Louis Park
suburbs.housingCharacter: Most of the city was built in one burst after the war: about sixty percent of homes date from the late 1940s to the early 1950s, and the most common house is a Cape Cod or small rambler. Neighborhoods like Brooklawns and Cobblecrest are mostly 1940s and 1950s ranch homes and bungalows, while Fern Hill mixes 1 1/2 story post-war homes, Cape Cods, colonials and mid-century moderns. Elmwood is the exception, with some homes from the 1890s.

conditions.condition: Most homes are compact post-war Cape Cods, 1 1/2 stories and small ramblers
conditions.implication: Steep, narrow stairs to finished upper half-stories and small rooms with built-ins and older trim gather dust in corners and on ledges that need detail work by hand.

conditions.condition: The Cedar Lake Trail runs through neighborhoods such as Bronx Park, and Minnehaha Creek runs through the city
conditions.implication: Walkers, bikers and dogs coming home off the trail and creek paths carry grit and damp onto entry floors, so the front and back entries take the heaviest wear.

suburbs.name: Edina
suburbs.housingCharacter: Edina's oldest neighborhoods are in the east: the Country Club District, built from 1924 into the early 1930s, is full of period revival homes, and Morningside is mostly bungalows from 1905 to 1940. Most of the city grew between 1945 and 1974, so ramblers, Cape Cods and split-levels are common, and many are now being torn down and replaced with larger two-story homes. To the west, Indian Hills has rolling hills, larger lots and more privacy.

conditions.condition: Steady teardown and rebuild activity in east Edina and in western neighborhoods like Countryside and Indian Hills
conditions.implication: Next-door construction puts fine dust on window sills, ledges and floors, and a newly built home needs a thorough post-construction clean before move-in.

conditions.condition: Older period revival homes in the Country Club District and bungalows in Morningside
conditions.implication: Original woodwork, plaster detail, built-ins and older windows hold dust in their profiles and need gentle hand cleaning rather than harsh products.

suburbs.name: Inver Grove
suburbs.housingCharacter: Inver Grove Heights spans several generations: one-story ramblers from the late 1950s and 1960s, a large share of homes from the 1970s through the 1990s, and townhome communities such as Arbor Pointe beside its golf course. On the south side, new single-family and villa neighborhoods like Scenic Hills and Peltier Reserve are still being built.

conditions.condition: New single-family and villa homes are still going up in Scenic Hills and Peltier Reserve
conditions.implication: Construction dust from the homes being built nearby drifts in and settles on window sills, door tracks, vents and baseboards, and a newly finished home needs a deep first clean to lift the leftover drywall dust.

conditions.condition: Arbor Pointe's townhomes sit next to the Arbor Pointe Golf Course
conditions.implication: Grass clippings and damp turf come in on shoes and golf bags, so entry floors and the closet or garage door where gear is dropped need regular attention.

suburbs.name: Maple Grove
suburbs.housingCharacter: Maple Grove is built around its lakes, with many subdivisions named for Fish Lake, Rice Lake and Weaver Lake and built in numbered phases. Neighborhoods mix two-story and ranch-style homes, and newer areas like the Lakes at Maple Grove pair large two-story homes with townhomes from the 2010s. Around Arbor Lakes, the residential communities date mostly from the 2000s, with villas and townhome-style living close to downtown shops.

conditions.condition: Many neighborhoods sit beside Fish Lake, Rice Lake and Weaver Lake, and Weaver Lake Park is close to tree-lined streets
conditions.implication: Lake sand, damp towels and dog paws come through the door all summer, so entry floors, mudroom tile and lower-level carpet take the most wear.

conditions.condition: Large two-story homes are common in newer subdivisions such as the Lakes at Maple Grove
conditions.implication: Open stairways, high ledges and tall windows in two-story foyers collect dust out of easy reach and need a crew that works top to bottom.

suburbs.name: Maplewood
suburbs.housingCharacter: Most Maplewood homes were built after 1950, and split-level homes are very common, alongside midcentury ranches and some early 2000s townhouses. Maplewood Heights has Neocolonial, split-level and ranch-style homes, while Carver Ridge has custom-built ranch and split-level homes from the late 1980s on spacious lots. A smaller set of older homes from the 1920s to 1960s sits on the shoreline around Keller Lake.

conditions.condition: Split-level homes are very common across the city
conditions.implication: The front landing and the short stair runs up and down from it take most of the foot traffic, so stairs and the entry floor need attention every visit.

conditions.condition: Carver Ridge and Highwood East sit beside Carver Lake Park, Fish Creek Natural Area and preserves on quiet, tree-lined streets
conditions.implication: Leaves, needles and trail dirt come in on shoes and pets, so entry mats, mudroom floors and baseboards near the doors collect the most debris.

suburbs.name: St. Paul
suburbs.housingCharacter: St. Paul is a city of older homes on established streets. Summit Hill keeps many of its original Victorian houses, Highland Park is built mostly of large early 20th century homes with midcentury ramblers at its south end and Tudors near the golf course, and Macalester-Groveland mixes bungalows and Craftsman homes from around 1919. In Como Park more than 80% of homes were built before 1960, mostly single-family houses near the lake.

conditions.condition: Much of the housing stock is a century old: Victorians in Summit Hill, bungalows and Craftsman homes in Macalester-Groveland, and pre-1960 homes across Como Park
conditions.implication: Original woodwork, trim, built-ins and detailed staircases collect dust in grooves and ledges that newer homes do not have, and need hand-detailing rather than a quick wipe.

conditions.condition: Homes around Como Lake sit a few blocks from the lake's perimeter walking path, the park, zoo and golf course
conditions.implication: Walkers and dogs coming back from the lake path track grit and damp onto entry floors and rugs, so entries and the first stretch of flooring need extra attention.

suburbs.name: New Brighton
suburbs.housingCharacter: Most homes on the market in New Brighton date from the 1960s, with a smaller share from the 1970s. Split-entry and bi-level houses are the most common style, alongside mid-century ramblers, some with walk-out lower levels, and the occasional four-level split.

conditions.condition: Many homes are 1960s split-entry and bi-level houses, with some 1970s four-level splits
conditions.implication: Every trip in and out crosses the short stair runs off the front landing, so those carpeted stairs and the entry tile wear fastest and need attention every visit.

conditions.condition: Long Lake Regional Park has a sandy swimming beach and paved trails that join the Rice Creek trail system
conditions.implication: In summer, beach sand and damp towels come home with families, so entry floors, bathrooms and laundry areas collect grit that needs vacuuming before mopping.

suburbs.name: Plymouth
suburbs.housingCharacter: Much of Plymouth is established but not old, with many homes built between about 1970 and the mid-2000s. Around Medicine Lake the homes run from updated lake cottages to larger custom builds, while areas like Parkers Lake have newer developments and townhome communities sit near Bass Lake. New-home communities such as Camelot 9 are still going up on wide homesites near ponds and wetlands.

conditions.condition: Homes sit near Medicine Lake, Parkers Lake and Bass Lake, with trails winding around the lakes
conditions.implication: Sand, damp and grass come in on shoes, paws and lake gear, so entry floors, mudroom tile and the lower level need extra attention through the warm months.

conditions.condition: Creekside Hills and Elm Creek Highlands sit in wooded settings with Elm Creek and walking trails running through
conditions.implication: Leaf litter, pollen and trail dirt drift in through patio doors and settle on sills and floors near the back of the house.

suburbs.name: Richfield
suburbs.housingCharacter: Richfield is a first-ring suburb built mostly in one burst: the majority of its single-family homes went up in the 1950s, with a median build year of about 1959, and its apartments date from the 1960s and early 1970s. The houses are modest in size, mainly capes, one-and-a-half-story homes and ramblers on regular city streets. The oldest homes are around Wood Lake Nature Center, where condos and 55+ buildings also cluster.

conditions.condition: Wood Lake Nature Center, a 150-acre city nature park with homes and condo buildings around it
conditions.implication: Residents who walk the nature-center trails bring in mud, leaves and seeds on shoes and dogs' paws, so entry rugs and hard floors near the door need the most work.

conditions.condition: Most homes are 1940s and 1950s capes, one-and-a-half-story houses and ramblers
conditions.implication: Older, compact homes have original trim, built-ins and steep, narrow stairs up to finished half-story bedrooms, which collect dust and need careful hand detailing rather than a quick pass.

suburbs.name: Roseville
suburbs.housingCharacter: Roseville is a first-ring suburb whose housing is mostly mid-century: close to half of its homes date from the 1950s and 1960s, and about half of all units are single-family detached houses. The typical home from that era is a one-story rambler, some with a walkout lower level.

conditions.condition: Much of the housing is 1950s and 1960s one-story ramblers, some with walkout lower levels
conditions.implication: Living space is spread over one main floor plus a finished lower level, so the walkout door and lower-level floors pick up yard dirt and need the same attention as the main entry.

conditions.condition: Central Park and its paved loop around Lake Bennett, plus trails at Langton Lake and Reservoir Woods, are used by walkers and dog owners
conditions.implication: Households that walk the lake trails bring grit, damp and grass in on shoes and paws, so entry floors and mudroom areas get the heaviest wear.

suburbs.name: Savage
suburbs.housingCharacter: Much of Savage was built between 1970 and 1999, with about 40% of homes from 2000 or later. Split-entry and four-level split homes from the late 1980s and 1990s are common, often with walkout lower levels. Newer pockets such as Woodhill have larger two-story homes on wooded, roughly 0.4-acre lots built around 2001.

conditions.condition: Wooded, hilly lots in areas like Woodhill, and yards backing onto natural land
conditions.implication: Leaves, pine needles and dirt get tracked in through walkout doors and decks, and tree pollen settles on sills and screens, so lower-level floors and window tracks need regular attention.

conditions.condition: Many homes are four-level and split-entry designs
conditions.implication: Several short stair runs and a landing at the front door take the heaviest foot traffic, so stairs and entry flooring get dirty faster than the rest of the house.

suburbs.name: Wayzata
suburbs.housingCharacter: Wayzata's homes run from minimal traditionals and Tudor cottages to condos and townhouses near a walkable downtown, with larger estates along the shores of Lake Minnetonka. Areas such as Bushaway and Holdridge began as summer homes and estate-style farms before joining the city in 1956, and Highcroft has mid-century homes, some since renovated.

conditions.condition: Larger estates sit along the Lake Minnetonka shore, and life here centres on boating and the lakefront
conditions.implication: Lake sand, damp from the dock and boat gear come in through lake-side doors, so walkout levels, entry tile and the floors nearest the water need the most attention.

conditions.condition: Condos and townhouses sit close to a walkable downtown on the lake
conditions.implication: Smaller homes with shared hallways and heavy daily foot traffic from walks into town benefit from regular entry and floor care between deeper cleans.

suburbs.name: Woodbury
suburbs.housingCharacter: Woodbury is young: its median home was built in 2005. Planned neighborhoods such as Dancing Waters, Stonemill Farms and Bailey's Arbor were built out in phases, mixing single-family homes with townhomes, and Stonemill Farms has homes from 2003 through the mid-2010s, many on walkout lots. Eagle Valley has custom homes from around 2000 alongside some older 1970s to 1990s houses.

conditions.condition: Stonemill Farms has a shared pool, splash pad, ice rink, ponds and miles of walking paths
conditions.implication: Wet swimsuits, towels and trail shoes come straight into the house in summer, so entry floors, laundry rooms and bathrooms take the brunt.

conditions.condition: Many newer homes sit on walkout lots with a finished lower level opening onto the yard
conditions.implication: The lower level gets its own back-door traffic of grass and dirt, so a clean covers two entries and two living levels, not just the main floor.

suburbs.name: Vadnais Heights
suburbs.housingCharacter: Most of the older homes in Vadnais Heights are ranch-style and split-level houses built in the 1970s and 1980s, with newer two-story homes in the neighbourhoods around the lakes. John Mitchell Preserve holds large late-1990s two-stories and walkout ramblers on cul-de-sacs by Vadnais Lake, while Heritage Estates is association-managed townhomes.

conditions.condition: Older housing is largely 1970s and 1980s ranches and split-levels
conditions.implication: Split-level homes funnel every trip through a short stair run off the entry landing, so those stairs and the entry floor need attention every visit.

conditions.condition: Vadnais-Snail Lakes Regional Park, with East and West Vadnais Lakes and about 12 miles of mostly paved trail, sits beside the city
conditions.implication: Families who walk the lake trails or use Snail Lake Beach bring sand and damp onto entry floors and into bathrooms and laundry areas.

conditions.condition: Lakeside homes in John Mitchell Preserve are large walkout two-stories and ramblers of 3,000 to 4,000+ square feet
conditions.implication: Big finished walkout lower levels open straight onto the yard, so the lower-level door and floors pick up as much grass and grit as the front entry.

services.serviceIntro: Ivy Cleans is known to provide an array of professional cleaning services including home cleaning services and maid service in Minneapolis and nearby cities. Whether it’s residential or commercial cleaning, or even office upkeep, our team of professional house cleaners, with their years of experience, are equipped to handle any cleaning job, regardless of its size. We utilize top-notch cleaning products and equipment to ensure the best possible results for our clients. Understanding that people lead busy lives, we offer flexible services tailored to their convenience.

Whether you live in a quiet suburb or the bustling heart of Minneapolis, one thing is certain – dusting is an unavoidable part of maintaining a clean home. With its varied climate, Minneapolis is prone to dust and allergen accumulation. Our dusting services ensure a breathable, dust-free environment for you and your family.

Given Minneapolis’ infamous cold winters where indoor living is predominant, maintaining clean floors and carpets is vital. Our professional vacuuming services guarantee a home cleared of grime and dust, providing a sanitized and welcoming living environment.

Just like the janitorial services we offer for local businesses, our residential cleaning services include comprehensive bathroom cleaning – a necessary yet often dreaded task. Despite Minneapolis’ unpredictable weather, it’s essential to ensure a clean and sanitized bathroom environment. Our bathroom cleaning services aim to eliminate germs and bacteria, providing a safe and healthy space for your family.

The cold and snow-laden winters of Minneapolis might make window cleaning a daunting task but fret not as Ivy Cleans has got you covered. Our professional window cleaners ensure your windows are sparkling clean, free from dirt and streaks, providing a noticeably brighter living space.
sections.services.cards.dusting: Dusting is an essential part of keeping a home clean and healthy. Minneapolis area is known for its diverse climate, which can contribute to the buildup of dust and allergens in homes. Our dusting services ensure that your home is free from dust and other airborne particles, providing a healthier living environment for you and your family.
sections.services.cards.vacuuming: Vacuuming is another crucial cleaning service that is particularly important in Minneapolis. The city’s cold winters mean that people spend more time indoors, leading to a buildup of dirt and debris on floors and carpets. Our professional vacuuming services ensure that your home is free from dirt and dust, providing a more pleasant and hygienic living environment.
sections.services.cards.bathroom: Bathroom cleaning is a task that many homeowners find daunting, but it is crucial for maintaining a clean and healthy home. In Minneapolis, where the weather can be unpredictable, maintaining a clean and hygienic bathroom is particularly important. Our bathroom cleaning services ensure that your bathroom is free from germs and bacteria, providing a safe and healthy environment for you and your family.
sections.services.cards.window: Window cleaning is another essential service that is particularly important in Minneapolis. With its cold and snowy winters, it can be challenging to keep windows clean and clear. Our professional window cleaning services ensure that your windows are free from dirt, grime, and streaks, providing a clearer view and a brighter, more inviting living space.
sections.services.cards.upholstery: Upholstery cleaning is a service that is often overlooked but is crucial for maintaining a clean and healthy home. Minneapolis residents spend a lot of time indoors during the winter months, and this can lead to a buildup of dirt and allergens on upholstered furniture. Our upholstery cleaning services ensure that your furniture is free from dust, dirt, and allergens, providing a more comfortable and healthy living environment.
sections.deep.whatIs: Deep cleaning is a comprehensive cleaning service that goes beyond regular cleaning tasks. It involves a thorough cleaning of all surfaces, floors, carpets, and furniture in your home, with the goal of removing dirt, dust, and other allergens that may be lurking in your home. By doing so, deep cleaning helps to create a healthier and more comfortable living environment for you and your family.
about.story: Ivy Cleans is a local house cleaning company in Minneapolis, Minnesota. We have cleaned homes here since 2023, and Bailey leads a crew of 4 who have cleaned 300 homes across the city between them.
We are a small crew, and we would rather be known for the homes we have cleaned than for what we say about ourselves. If you would like yours to be the next one, call us or book online.
sections.suburb.house-cleaning-apple-valley.intro: At Ivy Cleans, we clean homes all across Apple Valley, from the older split-levels in Scott Highlands to the newer houses around Cobblestone Lake. A clean home is one you can relax in, so we plan every visit around your house and the way your family actually uses it. Contact us today to book your quote, and let our team take the cleaning off your list.
sections.suburb.house-cleaning-apple-valley.homes: If you live in Apple Valley, you know the town has two kinds of houses. In Scott Highlands and the older additions, many homes are split-entry and three-level splits, with a small landing at the door and short carpeted stairs going up and down from it. Around Cobblestone Lake, the homes are newer, with open rooms, bigger kitchens, and townhomes and detached villas mixed in among single-family houses. Whether your home is in Palomino Hills, Cedar Isle or anywhere in between, our cleaners come ready for the house you actually have. Just give us a call and we’ll make your home cleaner and tidier than ever.
sections.suburb.house-cleaning-apple-valley.local: The benefits of our house cleaning in Apple Valley really show at the front door. Families around Cobblestone Lake use the paved trail, the docks and the pool all year, and sand, lake damp and grass clippings come home on shoes and paws. We wash the entry floors, vacuum the stairs edge to edge, and wipe down the baseboards and lower walls where that dirt ends up. In the split-levels of the older neighborhoods, the front landing gets the same care, because every trip in and out of the house crosses it. Nothing by the door gets skipped.
sections.suburb.cleaning-services-eden-prairie.in: At Ivy Cleans, we clean homes all over Eden Prairie, from the gated streets of Bearpath to the established neighborhoods along Cardinal Creek. Many homes here are large, with more rooms, stairs and windows than most, and we give each one the time it needs instead of rushing through. Contact us today to book your quote, and let our team handle the cleaning while you enjoy your home.
sections.suburb.cleaning-services-eden-prairie.ho: If you live in Eden Prairie, you know the homes here are built big. Along Cardinal Creek there are houses with more than 5,000 square feet of finished space, where the lower level gets used as much as the main floor. Bearpath, set along its golf course, has custom two-story homes and single-story golf villas. Amsden Hills and Bent Creek are two more neighborhoods we serve. In homes this size, dust collects on tall trim, ceiling fans, stair spindles and the tops of cabinets, and we clean all of it, not just what’s at eye level. Give us a call and we’ll get your home cleaner than ever.
sections.suburb.cleaning-services-eden-prairie.lo: What makes our cleaning in Eden Prairie worth it is the planning. Bearpath is gated with a staffed entrance, so we arrange access with you before the first visit. Inside, fine clippings from the golf course come in on shoes and golf bags, collect in the patio-door tracks and get walked across the floors. Homes here are among the newest in the metro, with big garages, busy entries and plenty of time spent outdoors, and our visits are planned around all three. Contact us today to book your quote, and let us handle the cleaning.
sections.suburb.cleaning-services-shakopee.homes: Most Shakopee homes are fairly new, with only a small share more than a few decades old. Southbridge, in the northeast of the city, is mostly two-story and modified two-story homes, with some multi-level splits. Amberglen is a newer neighborhood of four- and five-bedroom homes with three-car garages, including raised ranch plans. The oldest homes sit near Downtown Shakopee along the river. Bigger, newer homes mean more bedrooms, more bathrooms and more floor to cover. Call us and we’ll plan a visit that covers all of it.
sections.suburb.cleaning-services-shakopee.local: Southbridge has a walking trail leading to a playground and an off-leash dog park, so dog walks and park trips bring paw prints, grass and dirt in through the entry. We give the floors by the door and the rugs attention on every visit and take care of the pet hair on the furniture. In homes with three-car garages, a lot of grit comes in through the garage entry too, so we clean that doorway as carefully as the front one and keep the mudroom floor clear.
